curtain ring onion ringsButtermilk soaked onion rings in crisp golden beer batter.How to make it2 brown onions150ml buttermilk120g plain flour150ml lager1/4 tsp salt1 L neutral oil, for fryingSlice golden.Drain and serve hot.Truck stop smoky pepper beef jerkySmoky as the burnt-out rental carHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin strips of topside marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and smoked paprika, dried slowly in the oven until chewy, finished with cracked pepper.Freeze 600g beef topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick with the grain.Mix 80ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp cracked black pepper.Marinate the beef overnight.Pat dry, lay on wire racks over trays and dry at 75°C with the oven door slightly open for 3 to 4 hours until leathery but bendy.Cool and store in a jar.MainsThanksgiving turkey slidersRoast turkey with cranberry, baked stuffing and gravy in soft buns.How to make it700g for 6 hours.Drain, pat dry and roast at 170°C until the centre reaches 70°C for 2 minutes.Make the stuffing mix with the packet water amount, spread in a small dish and bake beside the turkey, then cut into squares.Rest the turkey and slice.Melt the butter, stir in the flour for a minute, whisk in the stock and simmer for gravy.Fill the buns with turkey, cranberry sauce, stuffing squares and a Fry until golden and cooked through.Melt the rest of the butter in the pan, stir in 2 tbsp of the flour, then whisk in the rest of the milk and the pepper for the gravy.Boil the beans and serve with the chicken, mash and gravy.SweetsThanksgiving pumpkin pieSpiced roast pumpkin custard in pastry, served with whipped cream.How to make it450g peeled pumpkin250g sweet shortcrust pastry2 eggs80g brown sugar200ml thickened cream1/2 tsp cinnamon1/4 tsp ground ginger1/4 tsp nutmegRoast the pumpkin at 200°C until soft, then puree.Line a 20cm pie dish with the pastry and blind-bake with paper and weights at 180°C, then remove the weights and bake again.Whisk the puree with eggs, sugar, half the cream, cinnamon, ground ginger and nutmeg.Pour into the crust and bake at 170°C until just set.Cool, whip the remaining cream softly and serve.DrinksHome for Thanksgiving apple cider punchCloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange, spiked with bourbon for the grown-ups, served warm in mugs with a cinnamon stick.How to make it1.5 L cloudy apple juice3 cinnamon sticks6 cloves1 orange, sliced2 tbsp brown sugar120ml bourbonPut the apple juice, two cinnamon sticks, cloves, orange and sugar in a saucepan.Simmer gently for 15 minutes without boiling.Strain into a jug and pour into four mugs.Add bourbon to each adult mug and serve with a fresh cinnamon stick.
